<div class="card-body">
'''Full Scale Alert''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">厳戒態勢</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して、運命数を引く。運命数＜場のストームトルーパーの数ならば、このターンが終わるまで敵は移動できなくなる。ただし、密輸屋と彼らの乗っている宇宙船だけは、普通に移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-246o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国のストームトルーパーによる保安態勢は極めて厳重だ。発達した通信網と圧倒的な数の優位によって、反乱軍の帝国領内への移動を抑えこむ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Full Alert.

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force and draw destiny. If destiny is less than the number of stormtroopers on table, the opponent cannot move until the end of the turn. Smugglers and the starships they are aboard may still move normally.

'''Lore:''' Imperial stormtroopers maintain exceptionally tight security. Advanced communications and overwhelming numbers suppress Rebel movement within Imperial territory.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Full Scale Alert]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
